pairs.l: 1 — information technology has made the world more democratic?
2 — social media is generally good for us?
3 — social media causes mental health problems?
6 — technology has raised the level of inequality?
7 — the big tech companies have become too powerful?
9 — their grandparents are addicted to social media?
10 — digital technology has resulted in lower quality entertainment?
11 — music streaming is equivalent to theft?

r1.exp: 1=D (Damien: 'before the internet only POWERFUL PEOPLE HAD ACCESS to it. These days WE ALL DO'). 2=A (Arthur: 'anything that makes us COMMUNICATE MORE is alright by me'). 3=C (Carlota: 'apps like Facebook, Instagram and TikTok can make insecure teenagers ANXIOUS AND DEPRESSED'). 4=A (Arthur: 'the most important activity is to focus on making the digisphere a SAFER PLACE'). 5=F (Freya: 'ROBOTS HAVE TAKEN OUR JOBS'). 6=F (Freya: 'technology has PRIVILEGED SOME PEOPLE OVER OTHERS'). 7=B (Betty: 'Google, Apple and Amazon being TOO BIG and not paying enough taxes. THEY CAN GET AWAY WITH ANYTHING'). 8=E (Ezra: 'my mum and dad love Facebook, but MY GENERATION WOULDN'T TOUCH IT'). 9=B (Betty: 'I've even got Gran and Granpa into it. They can't live WITHOUT THEIR FACEBOOK'). 10=E (Ezra: 'the problem with user content is that TOO MANY USERS DON'T HAVE ANY TALENT'). 11=D (Damien: 'we can switch on music like tapwater and the artists get no benefit. THAT'S JUST STEALING'). 12=C (Carlota: 'everything is moving SO FAST THESE DAYS it's IMPOSSIBLE TO KEEP UP').

r13.exp: 'Shouting for someone to hurl a football... so he could MAKE A LEAPING CATCH' = htio skočiti i uhvatiti loptu u zraku = D.

r14.exp: 'Doctors kept him there overnight FOR OBSERVATION' = medicinski nadzor = D.

r15.exp: 'He'd been seeing BLACK-AND-WHITE SQUARES scrolling in his mind... his body was intuitively READING THEM AS NOTES' = produkt vizualnih slika u umu = C.

r16.exp: 'Mind CONTINUOUSLY AND UNBEARABLY FLOODED with squares and tunes and rhythms' = glazba se nije prestajala pojavljivati = A.

r17.exp: 'The persistent fear that the root of it all was something DEADLY that would bring his life to a halt' = strah da je uzrok smrtonosna bolest = D.

r18.exp: 'Undamaged tissue is RECRUITED from the right hemisphere as a way to COMPENSATE FOR THE LOSS' = mozak se oporavlja od traume = B.

r19.exp: 'This unique fish represents a linguistic puzzle. (19)______. Some resemble human forms, animals and plants...' → D: It is covered with ROWS OF STYLIZED SIGNS, so called GLYPHS. 'Some resemble...' refers to the glyphs.

r20.exp: 'Tablets brought by first settlers between 800 and 1200. (20)______. Some believe it predated European contact.' → A: REGARDLESS OF THE WORD OF MOUTH, academics DISAGREE ABOUT WHEN the writing system emerged.

r21.exp: 'Difficult task. (21)______. Only 26 rongorongo objects exist.' → F: This is mainly so DUE TO THE LACK OF ARTEFACTS.

r22.exp: 'Each sign represents an object to be spoken aloud. (22)______. Building on THEM, the reader fills in unwritten text from memory.' → C: However, THESE SIGNS ARE MERELY SYMBOLIC PROMPTS.

r23.exp: 'Limited information, most cannot be identified. (23)______. Researchers have announced an algorithm to decipher a lost language.' → H: But there are HOPES MACHINE LEARNING COULD HELP in the future.

r24.exp: 'Glyphs generate significant PRIDE and intrigue. (24)______. On the other hand, the script is as much a MYSTERY for them.' → E: For the locals they are a source of GREAT ADMIRATION AND AWE towards their ancestors.

r25.exp: 'Might spill its contents everywhere UNLESS it is zipped shut' — 'unless' = osim ako, ako ne (negiran uvjet).

r26.exp: 'Too busy PROMOTING the sewing machine' — 'too busy + gerund' = preznajut za + gerund.

r27.exp: 'It DIDN'T HAVE much success' — simple past za prošlu činjenicu (historijski kontekst).

r28.exp: 'Increased the number of elements TO 10 per inch' — prijedlog 'to' za dostizanje određene vrijednosti (increase to = povećati na).

r29.exp: 'Didn't come up WITH the name' — frazalni glagol: come up with = smisliti, osmisliti.

r30.exp: 'It TOOK another 20 years before...' — fiksna konstrukcija: it takes (time) = trebati (vremenski period).

r31.exp: 'Kept our lives together IN many ways' — fiksni izraz: in many ways = na mnogo načina.

r32.exp: 'Though NONE convinced the general public' — 'none' = nitko od njih (none of them).

r33.exp: 'Rice, HOWEVER, is not white in its original form' — 'however' za kontrast (people think rice is white, however...).

r34.exp: 'Most nutrients removed and is THUS less healthy' — 'thus' = dakle, stoga (logical consequence).

r35.exp: 'Higher chances of a RISE in blood glucose levels' — 'a rise in' = porast u (noun: a rise).

r36.exp: 'Raised blood glucose levels LEAD to diabetes' — fiksna kolokacija: lead to = dovesti do.

r37.exp: 'Takes longer to digest DUE TO its high fibre content' — 'due to' + noun = zbog.

r38.exp: 'As THIS cuts down the frequency of hunger' — 'this' = fibre (referira se na prethodno navedeno visoko vlakno).

r39.exp: 'May help IMPROVE the health of the heart' — 'help + infinitive' = pomoći poboljšati.

r40.exp: 'The deficiency of THESE two (B vitamins and magnesium) is associated with heart failure' — 'these' = zamjenica za prethodno navedena dva elementa.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA negativan utjecaj: nerealne slike tijela, konzumerizam, loši uzori, anksioznost, cyberbullying. ZA bezopasno: zabava, inspiracija, informacije, kreativnost. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
